Portfolio + business card: three directions

Proof mock-ups, not final builds. Same content in all three; they differ in structure, genre and signature element. Pick one, combine parts, or reject.

A

Control Plane

Infrastructure tool / operator console. Split rail: your card pinned left, systems scroll right, a live map of how the projects connect.

B

The Broadsheet

Technical publication. Light paper broadsheet grid, numbered case studies, a printed card in the masthead that flips to the QR.

C

The Card

Premium product page around one object. A rotatable business card (QR on its back), then the portfolio dealt as a deck of cards.
